newsHighlights.title: Vice-minister Liao's name proposed for IMF role
newsHighlights.summary: The expected succession of IMF Deputy Managing Director Li Bo by a veteran Chinese fiscal policymaker would maintain continuity in China's representation, experts said.
newsHighlights.translation: 专家表示，中国资深财政政策制定者有望接替国际货币基金组织副总裁李波，这将保持中国在该机构代表权的连续性。

newsHighlights.title: China expands foreign business access at Hainan FTP
newsHighlights.summary: China has expanded foreign business access at the Hainan Free Trade Port, opening more sectors to overseas companies and sending a clear signal to international investors.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国扩大了海南自由贸易港的外资准入范围，向海外企业开放更多领域，向国际投资者发出明确信号。

newsHighlights.title: Global South to become active builder of new order
newsHighlights.summary: "The Global South is no longer a silent partner. It has become an active architect of the new world order," former Kyrgyz prime minister Djoomart Otorbaev said at the Global Strategic Dialogue.
newsHighlights.translation: 吉尔吉斯共和国前总理奥托尔巴耶夫在全球战略对话上表示："全球南方不再是沉默的伙伴，而已成为世界新秩序的积极构建者。"

newsHighlights.title: 'Super students' ride tide of AI innovation
newsHighlights.summary: A new generation of Chinese students is riding the tide of AI innovation, turning classroom ideas into startups and new forms of international collaboration.
newsHighlights.translation: 新一代中国学生正乘着人工智能创新的浪潮，把课堂创意转化为创业项目和新的国际合作形式。

quote.quote: The single biggest problem in communication is the illusion that it has taken place.
quote.author: George Bernard Shaw
quote.translation: 沟通中最大的问题，就是误以为沟通已经发生了。
quote.explanation: 很多时候我们以为自己已经把话说清楚了，但对方其实并没有接收到。在职场中，确认对方是否真正理解，比单纯地传达信息更重要。

pattern.pattern: would + 动词原形：表示对预期结果的客观推测或说明
pattern.example: The expected succession of Li Bo by a veteran Chinese fiscal policymaker would maintain continuity in China's representation.
pattern.translation: 李波由一位资深的中国财政政策制定者接任，将保持中国在该机构代表权的连续性。
pattern.usage: 在职场与新闻英语中，用 would + 动词原形可以委婉、客观地描述某一举措可能带来的结果，避免把话说得太绝对。常见结构：The move/policy/appointment would + 动词（maintain, reduce, improve, signal...）。例如：The new arrangement would reduce costs for the whole team.

grammar.title: 现在完成时表示"变化的结果"
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时（have/has + 过去分词）常用来强调从过去某个时间点到现在所发生的变化及其结果。在职场沟通中，用它可以突出"如今的状态与过去不同"，常与 no longer、already、recently 等词搭配。
examples: The Global South is no longer a silent partner. It has become an active architect of the new world order.
China has expanded foreign business access at the Hainan Free Trade Port, and overseas companies have already started to respond.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 /ˈseʃ/ 上，首音节 /sək/ 读得轻而短。注意结尾是 /ʃn/，舌尖不接触上齿，气流从舌面与上颚之间摩擦而出，类似中文"申"但更轻。整词节奏为：轻—重—轻。
examples: The expected succession would not change China's overall approach.
A smooth succession of leadership is important for any team.

reading.title: China Opens Doors Wider and Keeps Its Seat Steady
reading.content:
China is widening the door for foreign companies. China Daily reports that the Hainan Free Trade Port has expanded foreign business access in several sectors, allowing overseas firms to enter markets that were once restricted. At the same time, the expected succession of IMF Deputy Managing Director Li Bo by a veteran Chinese fiscal policymaker would maintain continuity in China's representation, experts said.

For professionals, the two stories share one message: clear communication and stable partnerships matter. When policy signals are consistent, companies can plan ahead and negotiate with confidence. As former Kyrgyz prime minister Djoomart Otorbaev told the Global Strategic Dialogue, the Global South has become an active architect of the new world order.

In short, whether you are writing an email to a foreign client or presenting a proposal to your team, the ability to express ideas clearly and to listen carefully is what turns a simple conversation into real collaboration.
reading.translation:
中国正为外资企业敞开更宽的大门。据《中国日报》报道，海南自由贸易港已扩大多个领域的外资准入，让海外企业得以进入过去受限的市场。与此同时，专家表示，中国资深财政政策制定者有望接替国际货币基金组织副总裁李波，这将保持中国在该机构代表权的连续性。

对职场人士来说，这两条新闻传递着同一个信息：清晰的沟通与稳定的合作关系至关重要。当政策信号保持一致时，企业就能提前规划、自信谈判。正如吉尔吉斯共和国前总理奥托尔巴耶夫在全球战略对话上所说，全球南方已成为世界新秩序的积极构建者。

总之，无论你是给外国客户写邮件，还是向团队汇报方案，清晰表达想法并认真倾听的能力，才是把一次普通对话变成真正合作的关键。
reading.sourceNote: 本文改写自 China Daily 2026年10月30日新闻：《China expands foreign business access at Hainan FTP》《Vice-minister Liao's name proposed for IMF role》《Global South to become active builder of new order》，用于英语学习目的。
